text: The JRC GFC2020 V4 dataset shows that there was no forest on the property in 2020 (0 ha). However, the Hansen GFC GFC-2025-v1.13 dataset indicates a significant tree-cover loss event of 67.7 ha in 2020, suggesting that forest was present before that loss. Thus, the Hansen dataset implies forest was on the property in 2020, while the JRC dataset does not confirm it. The discrepancy may arise from differences in forest definition or detection methods between the datasets.
